title: [Audit] 🚨 Security & Anomalies
description: Mean-severity risk scoring, privileged operations, failures and newly seen identities.

config.description: Average severity weight across scoring events, on the same 0–50 scale as the weights: config change 50, key invalidation 45, failure 40, anonymous denial 35, destructive change 30, other Kibana change 25, workflow execution 10. Executions weigh least on purpose — they are the one class with unbounded cadence, and a scheduled workflow firing every minute would otherwise turn total risk back into an event count. Routine activity scores 0 and is excluded, so this is not a disguised event count — read it with Scoring events beside it.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL OR attributes.event.outcome == "failure" OR attributes.event.action IN ("invalidate_apikeys","anonymous_access_denied") OR (resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((attributes.event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR attributes.event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) | EVAL risk = CASE(attributes.event.action == "invalidate_apikeys", 45, attributes.event.action == "anonymous_access_denied", 35, attributes.elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL, 50, attributes.event.outcome == "failure", 40, (resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((attributes.event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR attributes.event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) AND attributes.event.action IN ("workflow_run","workflow_test","workflow_execution_cancel"), 10, (resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((attributes.event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR attributes.event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) AND (attributes.event.type == "deletion" OR attributes.event.action == "rule_disable"), 30, (resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((attributes.event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR attributes.event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))), 25, 0) | WHERE risk > 0 | STATS risk_total = SUM(risk), scoring_events = COUNT(*) | EVAL mean_severity = ROUND(1.0 * risk_total / scoring_events, 1) | EVAL `Mean severity` = mean_severity | KEEP `Mean severity`

config.description: Security configuration changes recorded by Elasticsearch.
API keys invalidated in range — legitimate rotation, or a credential being revoked in a hurry.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.event.action == "invalidate_apikeys" | STATS `Key invalidations` = COUNT(*)
FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.event.outcome == "failure" | STATS `Failures` = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.event.action == "anonymous_access_denied" | STATS `Anonymous denials` = COUNT(*)

config.title: 🚨 Security configuration changes
config.description: Raw security_config_change payloads. The field is a JSON string, shown verbatim — it names the exact API key ids or profile uids affected.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>"), actor_kind = CASE(attributes.user.email IS NOT NULL, "human", "service") | STATS events = COUNT(*), last_change = MAX(@timestamp) BY actor, action = attributes.event.action, change = attributes.elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change | SORT last_change DESC | LIMIT 12

config.title: Rare and privileged operations
config.description: Every action plotted against first occurrence. Smaller bubbles are rarer events; warmer colour is higher risk. Rare plus high-risk is where to look first.

config.title: Risk over time
config.description: Summed risk over time, routine activity excluded. Spikes are clusters of privileged, failed or denied activity.

config.title: Risk leaderboard
config.description: Identities ranked by total accumulated severity, so sustained behaviour outranks a single high-severity event. actor_scope separates Elastic platform automation from tenant identities — without it elastic.maintenance can top this table, because Elastic platform automation performs routine security config changes itself. Click an email to pin that identity across the whole suite.

config.title: Newly seen identities
config.description: Identities ordered by when they first appeared in the window. A brand-new identity at the top of this list is worth a question.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/main", "elastic.maintenance") OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/search*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/*point_in_time" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/open_reader_context")) AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("authentication_success","connection_granted"))) | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>"), actor_kind = CASE(attributes.user.email IS NOT NULL, "human", "service") | STATS first_seen = MIN(@timestamp), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp), events = COUNT(*), ips = COUNT_DISTINCT(client.ip) BY actor, actor_kind | SORT first_seen DESC | LIMIT 10

config.title: Failures and denials by identity
config.description: Failed and denied operations grouped by identity, action and source IP. Rows with no email are unauthenticated — those are external probes, not staff.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.event.outcome == "failure" OR attributes.event.action IN ("authentication_failed","realm_authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied") | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>"), actor_kind = CASE(attributes.user.email IS NOT NULL, "human", "service") | STATS events = COUNT(*), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY actor, attributes.user.email, action = attributes.event.action, ip = client.ip | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 10
